title: Shiraishi An — Light Up The Slopes〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, we're at the mall.
Let's start doing some shopping!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're here to buy stuff for when we go to stay at your dad's friend's lodge in the mountains, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But is there that much we need...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Snacks, drinks, sweets and such!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, don't snacks and sweets fall under the same category?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No way!
We need snacks for the drive over and sweets for after we get there♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, it's really nice that the four of us all get to go since the camping trip we went on was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Definitely!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've been so busy with events and stuff lately, so it'll be nice to spread our wings and relax during New Year's.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, we learned during our camping trip that doing stuff as a team matters a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! And performing at the lodge should be a good experience for all of us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only that... Skiing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I went skiing when I was really little, but haven't since... I'm not sure how I'll do after so long...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Is that all?
You'll be fine! I'll help you brush up when we're there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You will? Wait, An, I thought you wanted to go snowboarding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I do, but Toya's also a beginner, so we should help each other out until we all get the hang of things!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You mean it? Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now, let's start getting everything we need to make our skiing trip as fun as possible!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That includes the snacks I just mentioned, but we're also gonna need some cold-weather gear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'll be warm once we're on the slopes, but it's probably going to be cold otherwise.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, wanna get some hand warmers?
Let's see... Which shop sold daily necessities... Hm?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, check this out! It's an electric hand warmer!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a rabbit and a bear!
That's so cute! I didn't know they made these!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And this one looks like a macaron.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! Do you think Akito would try to eat it if we hid it in our sweets pile?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I know he has a sweet tooth, but I'm sure he'll realize what it is after he sees it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah...
But it's hilariously cute, so let's get it anyways!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That just leaves... Oh, they have warm and fluffy socks! We should get some to make sure our toes stay warm.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I almost forgot! Wanna get some games that we can play at the lodge after it gets dark? I have cards already, so how about a board game or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, that sounds like a lot to carry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry! We're gonna rent all our skiing equipment over there, so one or two board games won't hurt!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, what else is there...? Oh, this blanket's adorable! And big! We can probably use it together, Kohane, so I'll grab this too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you know what you're gonna buy, Kohane? Anything you like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll get some of those socks you just got.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, these do look nice!
And they feel so soft!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They come in a few different designs. Which do you wanna get?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... What if I got the one you chose but in a different color?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't mind, but I think some of these other really cute ones would suit you better...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I just thought that it might be fun to have matching pairs...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know this is different from when we do a show... Or do you think it'll be too embarrassing...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: K-Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I won't be embarrassed at all!
So, let's get matching pairs!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: While we're at it, wanna get matching scarves and beanies?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
Hehe. Then, let's take a closer look at what they have to offer...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
I hope we can put together some really cute outfits.
